messages:
Alex: quick night handoff — had a noisy 503 spike hitting embeddings in eu-west around 22:10 UTC, automated fallback to quantized-emb-v2 kicked in and reduced errors, still seeing elevated p95 for small requests :thinking_face:
incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-3213 — embeddings-eu-west-503-spike (sev:2) — paged @oncall at 22:11 UTC
Priya: I'll stay primary for the night till 04:00 UTC. Miguel will be shadow/secondary until 02:00 UTC.
Miguel: on call shadow, will take pages if Priya needs escalation. sitting by for runbook steps.
Alex: current status: fallback model active in eu-west (quantized-emb-v2), traffic split 80/20 to fallback. Customer impact: intermittent 503s for heavy batch embedding jobs; interactive embedding latencies up ~200ms p95. No data loss.
Priya: good catch on the batching bucket — I saw a batcher backlog metric spike (batcher.queue_size ~ 150 -> 900). I drained one backlog shard with `kubectl exec -n inference batcher-7 -c admin -- /scripts/drain.sh` and scaled batcher replicas +1.
Miguel: runbook refs: https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/embeddings-503 — steps 1.1 (drain shard) and 2.3 (fallback verify). also check `kube_events` and `redis-rate-limiter` hits.
ops-bot: Scale event: deployment batcher scaled from 3 -> 4 replicas by Priya at 22:27 UTC
Priya: verified fallback health: `curl -sS http://eu-west-fallback/health` -> `{ "ok": true, "model": "quantized-emb-v2" }`
Alex: outstanding coverage gap: no coverage engineer in APAC nights until 00:00 UTC — if we see region spillover to apac, we need to page Miguel directly and consider cross-region reroute.
Miguel: noted. I can open a temporary reroute if apac shows >5% error rate. command I use: `./tools/reroute --from eu-west --to eu-central --service embeddings` (will notify infra).
Priya: next steps for tonight:
- monitor batcher.queue_size and batcher.latency (alerts set)
- watch fallback error rate and model quality regression alerts (evals)
- if queue_size > 600 or 503 rate > 2%, escalate to Miguel and run full shard drain (runbook 1.4)
- update incident ticket with any customer-impacting events
Alex: handoff notes to morning: we expect to revert traffic to primary-emb-v3 once backlog stable < 100 for 30m and p95 latency < target for 15m. Leave runbook link in the ticket.
Priya: added runbook checklist to INC-2026-3213 and pinned logs. I'll chase a postmortem if we get a repeat in next 24h. :memo:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3213 updated: severity remains 2, current owner Priya, secondary Miguel.
Miguel: all set, I will shadow til 02:00 UTC then hand to EU morning team. ping me if escalation. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks team — leaving notes here and notifying customer success to send proactive heads-up for any customers with large batch jobs.
Priya: signing off then staying onshift. reach me on call if anything.
Alex: handoff complete — good luck and keep trace IDs in the ticket for any follow-ups.
